set.body:
Goal: extend the language-neutral wire IR (module multivar-ir) with nodes for the unified operator, the FunctionalFrame, the secondOrder/compress provenance, and the base-objective enum — additively, preserving schema v0.1 conformance semantics. Design: docs/plans/multivar-operator-core.md §3–§6.

Files: SemanticIr.scala (the live→IR bridge), IrModel.scala (the data model), MultivarIrCodec.scala (encode/decode), IrValidator.scala (structural + semantic validation). The IR is already 1:1 with the semantic layer; after the collapse it mirrors the ONLY layer, which is cleaner.

Acceptance: new nodes round-trip (encode → decode → validate) on JVM+JS; the existing conformance corpus still passes — conformance/valid/minimal-v0.1.json plus the 6 invalid fixtures (domain-codomain-mismatch, incompatible-alignment-kind, payload-tampered, uncertified-positivity, unknown-field, unsupported-singularity-for-reject-only); the validator still rejects domain/codomain mismatch, uncertified positivity, role coercion, and payload tampering; SHA-256 payload identities preserved (inline + external). Prefer additive fields; bump SchemaVersion only if a breaking change is unavoidable, and add a conformance fixture for any new rejection category.
set.title: Multivar-ir: extend the wire IR with unified-operator/FunctionalFrame/objective nodes
